description: Create a transaction rule. When a transaction matches the condition, the action is applied automatically.

action_field.description: Field to set: category, payee, payee_name, notes, account, amount, date, imported_payee, cleared, reconciled. Not category_group, which does nothing, and not transfer, parent or saved, which make every import that matches the rule fail as a whole. Setting account moves a transaction that arrives through a file import or a bank sync, and one you apply the rule to by hand, but not one recorded through this server, which keeps the account it was given. A later import of the same movement does not recognise the moved row, so a bank sync can leave a duplicate; a row moved off budget also loses its category.

action_value.description: Value to set (category name/ID, payee name/ID, account name/ID, note text, an amount as you would say it, or true or false for cleared and reconciled). A payee, category or account must already exist; use create_payee or create_category for a new one.

condition_field.description: Field to match: payee, payee_name, category, category_group, account, amount, notes, date, imported_payee, cleared, reconciled

condition_op.description: Operator: is, isNot, oneOf, notOneOf, contains, doesNotContain, matches, gt, lt, gte, lte. oneOf and notOneOf take a list. contains, doesNotContain and matches are refused on payee, category, category_group and account, which Actual stores as ids: they would compare against the id. For text on a payee, imported_payee holds what the row arrived with, and payee_name the payee name, once that payee exists. On amount the operators are is, isapprox, gt, gte, lt and lte; isNot is not one of them. On cleared and reconciled the only operator is is: for "not cleared", write cleared is false.

condition_value.description: Value to match against. For payee, category, category_group and account, a whole name or an ID. For amount, the figure as you would say it (45.50, or -45.50 for money going out), not in cents. Spending is negative, so "more than 45.50 spent" is lt -45.50: gt -45.50 would also catch every deposit and every zero. For cleared and reconciled, true or false; yes and 1 are read as true, no and 0 as false. Pass a list for oneOf and notOneOf; a single value for every other operator.

stage.description: When to apply: null (default), pre, or post

name: create_rule
